context: Yehsa medical entries are offline reference labels for a personal survival agent. They are not a diagnosis, a prescription, or a substitute for emergency services. In an emergency, contact local emergency services.
Serious bleeding needs direct pressure with clean cloth and urgent human help. This note does not teach surgery or medication dosing.
Clean water matters before wound rinsing or rehydration. Boil water when you can. This is a field reminder, not clinical instruction.
A mosquito bite is usually a small itchy spot. Wash it with clean water. Swelling of the face or throat, or trouble breathing, needs a person and emergency services, not a plant.
